==Description==
'''Meltdown''' is a winter-themed [[Maps|map]] that takes place in the hills.

==Design & Path==
'''Meltdown''' resembles an abandoned facility covered in snow. The facility has multiple small buildings and a larger one, which is open. It contains multiple barrels and wooden crates. Multiple street lights can also be seen next to the path, and a few dumpsters next to some buildings. The map is surrounded by hills and sparse trees. Lava can be seen flowing down from the hills.

The path begins at a cave and turns at a cliff. Then it takes a few right and left turns, each time going around obstacles. Then it wraps around a few trees, and finally into another cave.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Meltdown}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*There are quite a few decent cliff spots around the map, like the cliffs near the exit or near the middle, making cliff towers like the [[Ranger]] and [[Sniper]] highly viable.
**The [[DJ Booth]] can be used to increase their range, allowing them to cover most of the map.
*Ground towers should be placed around the middle of the map.
